key_insight: TreeC learns understandable residential energy-management strategies with competitive performance against model predictive control and reinforcement learning.
engineering_relevance: Coordinating batteries, heat pumps, EV charging, and photovoltaic systems can reduce household energy costs, especially in poorly insulated dwellings.
method: Compare rule-based, optimization, and machine learning controllers.
Develop TreeC to learn understandable energy-management strategies.
Evaluate methods in three simulation cases and one real-world experiment.
evidence_signal: The thesis reports competitive TreeC performance across diverse problems, but both TreeC and model predictive control performed worse on real hardware than in simulations.
watch_item: Deployment requires representative training data and reliable real-time inputs; average cost savings do not yet outweigh current implementation costs and effort.
paper_title: How to Effectively Manage the Energy in Residential Systems: Development and Comparison of Methods
